research_notes: Identify 2003–06 legal employers, obtain archived practice/professional records for full-time status and employment cessation, and reconcile 2015 APH versus approximate 2016 business chronology. Investigate reduced hours/leave and law-practice overlap with council from April 2012; neither full-time nor zero can be assumed.

2026-09-29 initial pass checked APH, first-person member/party biography, first speech, public 2017 government testimony, foundation board profile and contemporaneous ABC. Searched firm history, full-time status, pre-2006 employer and public professional profiles; similarly named overseas lawyers and sports writers rejected. No reliable individual hours or complete employer chain found.

The 2003–15 solicitor line is an umbrella, not a second job additional to Caldwell Solicitors. Do not sum overlapping entries or use ten years of business growth as ten eligible full-time years. Legal admission and mediator credentials are qualifications; council service and foundation governance are excluded.

Next archival leads: historical Queensland Law Society/practice directories and former Caldwell Solicitors website, council annual-report interest declarations for concurrent practice, and firm closure/transfer records. Primary council end date retained; unsupported secondary date not silently substituted. All date precision and unknown gaps preserved.
